fields.name: placements_done
fields.description: Integer count of completed placements of the goal-colored cube onto the target so far in the episode, counting the placement shown in this step's execution steps. It is 0 at step #1 and at every step whose execution steps do not contain a release of the cube over the target. It increases by exactly one at each decision step whose execution steps show the goal-colored cube labelled 'is held in the gripper' at some frame AND whose final scene shows that cube no longer labelled held, lying within a few pixels of the target position, with the fingers ~100% open (the step whose correct subgoal follows a 'place' command). No finger percentage or gripper height is required at any intermediate frame; the 'is held' label may lag a frame behind the actual release and is ignored at intermediate frames. A step in which the gripper closed on nothing (cube never labelled held) does not count even if the cube already sits on the target from an earlier placement. A step ending with the cube held does not count. It never decreases. e.g. 2
